items.title: Delfeayo Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And then Mark Turner. ... I brought Mark Turner in for a little while. Mark, again, was a good player.

ctx.x: That was your group that did that. You had Brian Blade, I think.
Brian Blade was there. Brian Blade. Early on I had Josh Redman, who I fired, which he’s happy I did that. And then Mark Turner.
